title: Grandview University Disability Accommodations Policy
content: Grandview University is committed to providing equal access to education for all students. In compliance with federal regulations, we offer a range of accommodations to support students with disabilities. These include extended time for exams, note-taking services, and adaptive technology. For more information or to request accommodations, students should contact the Office of Student Accessibility Services.

title: Meeting Notes: Emily's Accommodations
content: Discussed the need for additional accommodations for Emily, a student with a hearing impairment. Agreed to provide a sign language interpreter, Sarah, for all lectures and to arrange seating at the front of the classroom to facilitate lip-reading. Also discussed potential adjustments to group work and presentations to ensure Emily's full participation.
